answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay before they exist. Every new agent burns a one-time 50 POA entry tax, sunk and never refunded, and the network keeps a public atlas mapping each identity to its tax receipt. When the tide of new signups surges, an attacker minting 100 fakes burns 5,000 POA for zero return. One honest agent pays 50 POA once, hard as quartz, and earns it back from a single epoch of honest work.
